name: pytorch
description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration
one_liner: The core open-source engine that most AI and machine-learning software in the world is built on top of. Not something you'd use directly unless you're building AI models yourself.
buyer: Nobody buys PyTorch directly, it's free infrastructure. The people who benefit are ML engineers and researchers building other products on top of it.
business_use_cases: An ML team builds a custom model for fraud detection or demand forecasting using PyTorch underneath, then sells the resulting product or service.
A GPU cloud provider optimizes and resells compute specifically tuned for running PyTorch workloads.
A training and consulting business teaches companies how to build and deploy PyTorch models in-house.

money_ideas.idea: Offer PyTorch-based ML consulting or contracting to companies that want a custom model but lack in-house ML engineers.

steal_this: There's no weekend product here. PyTorch itself isn't sellable; the honest move is picking one narrow PyTorch-based model (a specific classifier, say) and selling access to that as an API.
